title: A bounded above complex of flat modules is K-flat
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a bounded above complex of flat modules is K-flat, and the proof is a 19-line argument that reduces the verification to a spectral sequence computation. It takes an acyclic complex L, an element of the cohomology of the total tensor product, and uses that the total complex is a direct sum in each degree to replace L by a suitable truncation, so that it becomes bounded above; on that truncation the first quadrant spectral sequence has first page terms that vanish because each P^q is flat and L is acyclic, forcing the cohomology of the total product to vanish. The truncation step and the spectral sequence identification are the two ingredients, and both are displayed.
